description:
Advances: specled.coverage_capture

Found by the specled_-dn4.9 audit (2026-07-26T00:25:30Z). specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta's statement covers the tolerant READ of a missing :meta, but never states the present-but-non-map rejection rule that store_test.exs now asserts after dn4.9 item 14. The test is ahead of the requirement.

Fix: state the rejection rule in the requirement so the assertion has an owning clause. Purely additive, so append-only-safe.

comments.text:
Resolved by branch specled_-td7/self-identifying-descriptors, commit 3bbd7e7b, while implementing specled_-n5s (session a5f50a6d-689f-4616-80ad-806b0595aa28).

n5s's fix needed an owning clause for write_v2/2's exception contract in specled.coverage_capture, and its new test asserts the present-but-non-map :meta rejection — leaving that rule unstated would have widened this ticket rather than left it alone. specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta now states: write_v2/2 tolerates a missing :meta on the same terms as read_v2/1, and rejects a present-but-non-map :meta as malformed. Covered by scenario specled.coverage_capture.scenario.envelope_meta_tolerant_read.

Not closing it here — that call belongs to whoever grades the PR. Verify against the branch and close if satisfied.

CORRECTION to my previous comment on this ticket — the earlier 'Resolved by' claim was OVERSTATED. Do not close npo on the specled_-td7 branch.

The cold verifier for specled_-n5s caught it: npo's mandate names a READ-path rule. The assertion npo says is unowned is store_test.exs 'read_v2 rejects envelopes with non-map :meta as invalid artifacts' (dn4.9 item 14), whose outcome is {:error, :invalid_artifact}. The clause I added to specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta has write_v2/2 as its grammatical subject throughout, so it gives the WRITE-path assertion an owning clause and leaves read_v2/1's rejection rule exactly as unstated as npo found it.

npo is at most half-discharged by that branch. Remaining work, per the verifier's suggested remedy: one clause stating that read_v2/1 classifies a present-but-non-map :meta as {:error, :invalid_artifact}.

Session: a5f50a6d-689f-4616-80ad-806b0595aa28
Log: /Users/mz/.claude-personal/projects/-Users-mz-src-specled-ex/a5f50a6d-689f-4616-80ad-806b0595aa28.jsonl

ADMISSION VERIFICATION (specled_-k6s, 2026-07-27)
Cold fresh-context verifier run against the epic base tree (feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors @ e81f9f98).

VERDICT: partially_done   EFFORT: trivial

== MANDATE AS ADMITTED (implement THIS, not the original description) ==
Single spec-prose edit, no code and no test change.

1. `.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md`, requirement `specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta` (statement block, lines 552-565): append one clause with `read_v2/1` as the grammatical subject, e.g. after line 565 — "`read_v2/1` shall classify an envelope whose `:meta` key is present but not a map as `{:error, :invalid_artifact}`, never as a well-formed envelope with a defaulted `meta: %{}`." The clause must be about the READ path and must name the `{:error, :invalid_artifact}` outcome; do NOT reword or remove the existing `write_v2/2` clause at 563-565 (it belongs to specled_-n5s, already landed on this branch).

2. Recommended (makes the assertion scenario-visible, not just requirement-visible): add one `then` line to `specled.coverage_capture.scenario.envelope_meta_tolerant_read` (lines 940-953), e.g. "an envelope whose present `:meta` is not a map reads back as `{:error, :invalid_artifact}`", and add a matching `given` line ("a v2 envelope whose `:meta` key holds a non-map term").

No change needed to `test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs` — the test at :307-323 already exists and already carries `@tag spec: "specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta"`. No change needed to `lib/specled_ex/coverage/store.ex` — `classify_v2/1` already implements the rule. No change needed to the `tagged_tests` verification block at lines 1076-1080 — `specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta` is already listed there with `execute: true`.

== EVIDENCE ==
The requirement statement in this tree (`.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md:551-565`) reads, in its final clause: "`write_v2/2` shall tolerate a missing `:meta` on the same terms as `read_v2/1` — it is additive, so an envelope without it is well-formed — and shall reject a present-but-non-map `:meta` as malformed." (lines 563-565). Every verb in that clause takes `write_v2/2` as its grammatical subject; `read_v2/1` appears only as the object of a comparison ("on the same terms as"). The earlier `read_v2/1` sentence (line 554-555) states only the TOLERANT read: "`read_v2/1` shall tolerate envelopes written without `:meta` (older artifacts default `meta: %{}`)". No clause states the read-path REJECTION rule.

The unowned assertion npo names is still present and still unowned: `test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs:307-323`:
    @tag spec: "specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta"
    test "read_v2 rejects envelopes with non-map :meta as invalid artifacts", %{path: path} do
      ... |> Map.put(:meta, [:not, :a, :map])
      assert {:error, :invalid_artifact} = Store.read_v2(path)
    end
Its outcome is `{:error, :invalid_artifact}` (read path), not an `ArgumentError` (write path).

The implementation the missing clause would own exists: `lib/specled_ex/coverage/store.ex:343-350`, `classify_v2/1`:
      case Map.get(envelope, :meta, %{}) do
        meta when is_map(meta) -> {:ok, Map.put(envelope, :meta, meta)}
        _ -> {:error, :invalid_artifact}
      end
(the write-path counterpart is a separate raise at store.ex:334-336, `raise(ArgumentError, "envelope :meta must be a map")`, owned by the new `specled.coverage_capture.write_v2_argument_error_contract` at line 568).

What td7 DID land is visible in `git diff main..HEAD -- .spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md` (commit 17b63ff6): +3 lines of write_v2 clause on envelope_meta, a whole new requirement `write_v2_argument_error_contract`, its scenario, and its addition to the `tagged_tests` verification block at line 1079. That confirms the 2026-07-27T00:10:19Z CORRECTION comment on the ticket (which retracts the 2026-07-26T20:58:34Z "Resolved by" claim) is accurate: npo is half-discharged, not discharged.

Scenario `specled.coverage_capture.scenario.envelope_meta_tolerant_read` (lines 940-953) likewise has no `then` clause for the read-path rejection; its four `then` lines cover missing-`:meta` read, `meta.boundary`, `meta.unmapped_modules`, and the write_v2 missing-`:meta` acceptance added by td7.

== RISK NOTES ==
- NO realization-hash impact. `.spec/realization_hashes.json` keys only code bindings (`api_boundary` entries such as `SpecLedEx.Coverage.Store.read_v2/1`); grep for "coverage_capture"/"envelope_meta" in that file returns zero hits. A statement-text edit touches no binding, so the realization-drift gate is unaffected. Corollary: if an implementer decides to also touch `lib/specled_ex/coverage/store.ex` (they should NOT — the behavior is already correct), `SpecLedEx.Coverage.Store.read_v2/1` IS a hashed api_boundary binding (spec file lines 134-135) and would require a baseline update.

- REQUIREMENT-ID DRIFT HAZARD, ordering-relevant: `specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta`'s statement was already amended on this branch by commit 17b63ff6 (specled_-n5s work). An implementer who diffs against `main` or pulls the requirement text from the npo ticket body will see the pre-td7 text and can silently clobber the `write_v2/2` clause at lines 563-565. Edit the tree's current text, append only.

- No other ticket in the set {4f7, wby, z5t, dn4.12, 26g, xkn.1, xkn.2, 4pl, ako, ehv, ozm, pii, yds, chb, 14t, 4a6, asb, b23, vbo, zd8, zek} mentions `coverage_capture` or `envelope_meta` (scanned all 21 bodies+comments), so `.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md` is uncontended.

- Adjacent-file-only overlap, not a true conflict: specled_-26g and specled_-ehv both edit `test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs` (26g: the `read_status/1` describe block's temp-dir setup around :330+; ehv: `System.tmp_dir!()` + `unique_integer` patterns repo-wide). npo requires zero edits to that file, so they cannot collide — but if a grader expands npo to add a redundant test there, it would.

- Gate cost: the verification leg covering `envelope_meta` is `kind: tagged_tests, execute: true` (lines 1076-1080), shared with `boundary_noop_unarmed` and `write_v2_argument_error_contract`. Bare `mix spec.check` will re-run that leg; `--no-run-commands` suffices to prove the structural edit is well-formed.

- No dependency on another ticket landing first; specled_-n5s (its prerequisite half) is already in this tree at 17b63ff6.

- Do not close npo on the strength of the 2026-07-26T20:58:34Z comment — the 2026-07-27T00:10:19Z comment explicitly retracts it.

SCOPE CONTRACT (orchestrator, specled_-k6s — 2026-07-27)

Authoritative for mechanical scope checks. The ADMISSION VERIFICATION comment
SUPERSEDES this ticket's description: npo is half-discharged by specled_-n5s
(already in main), and the remaining work is one spec-prose edit plus one
optional scenario line. Implement that, not the original description.

## Allowed touches
- `.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md` — and nothing else.
  - Item 1: APPEND one clause with `read_v2/1` as the grammatical subject to the
    `specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta` statement. Append only. Do NOT
    reword or remove the existing `write_v2/2` clause — it belongs to
    specled_-n5s and is already landed.
  - Item 2 (recommended): add one `given` and one `then` line to
    `specled.coverage_capture.scenario.envelope_meta_tolerant_read`.

## Out of Scope (files)
- `lib/specled_ex/coverage/store.ex` — `classify_v2/1` ALREADY implements the
  rule correctly. Touching it would drag the api_boundary-hashed
  `SpecLedEx.Coverage.Store.read_v2/1` binding into the diff. Do not touch it.
- `test/specled_ex/coverage/store_test.exs` — the covering test already exists at
  ~:307-323 and already carries `@tag spec: "specled.coverage_capture.envelope_meta"`.
  Adding a redundant test here is a scope violation and would collide with
  specled_-26g and specled_-ehv.
- The `tagged_tests` verification block — `envelope_meta` is already listed with
  `execute: true`. No change needed.
- `CHANGELOG.md` (orchestrator consolidates once at the end), `VERSION`,
  `.spec/realization_hashes.json`, `.spec/state.json`.
- Every file not listed under Allowed touches. This ticket should be a ONE-FILE diff.

## Out of Scope (intent)
- No code change and no test change. If you believe one is needed, stop and say so
  in the completion record rather than making it.
- Edit the TREE's current requirement text, appending to it. Do not paste the
  requirement text out of the ticket body or diff against `main` — both show the
  pre-n5s wording and would silently clobber the landed `write_v2/2` clause.
- Do not weaken spec prose or add a false `decisions:` link to quiet branch-guard.
  Use a `Spec-Drift:` commit trailer if branch-guard fires.

## Verification (change-scoped, run-until-green; host mix, no compose)
1. `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` — sufficient to prove the structural edit
   is well-formed.
2. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`
3. `git diff --name-only` must list exactly one file.

Do NOT run bare `mix spec.check` and do NOT run the full suite. The orchestrator
owns whole-system proof at the merge gate and PR CI.
